patternNote.sharedBuilder: scripts/rcap-agency-application/agency-application-build.mjs — reuse it; do not fork it. A row script is ~200 lines: evidence pins, anchors, optional heldForms, the instructions markdown, mustState/notHeld/findings/counselQuestions, then runCli(SPEC).
steps: 1. LANE TRUTH FIRST. Read the row's lane from the claim ledger (subjectType packet-family, operation packet-build, released false, subjectId = full worklistGroupId) and assert it with claim.mjs before reading anything else. NOT_GRANTED or ALREADY_RELEASED is a full stop for that row — record it and move on (AK in this return is the worked example).

2. FIND THE CONTROLLING EVIDENCE, NEWEST LAST. The legal-design memo is the start, not the end: a memo build_blocker may be superseded by a later counsel decision (AL: the 2026-08-28 research decision resolved the memo's route-existence blocker) or narrowed by a ratification (NM: hold_guidance permits exactly substantive guidance). Search data/record-clearing/legal-decisions/, the route-ratification registry, compiled profiles and route contracts, the census route record, and any committed guidance-packet or counsel-manifest record before concluding anything.

3. PIN AND ANCHOR. Every evidence file gets an exact SHA-256 pin; every load-bearing sentence in the instructions gets a literal quote anchor into a pinned file. Author anchors against the RAW file bytes (JSON escapes: quotes and newlines inside JSON strings will not match — pick quote spans without them). Run --check until clean before writing any output.

4. THE INSTRUCTIONS ANSWER FIVE QUESTIONS, from evidence only: which agency decides; what the application is; what the participant sends; what happens after; when to stop. Anything not held — a fee, an address, a processing time, an office name, an eligibility figure — is NEVER guessed: either quote it from pinned evidence or write a lookup instruction naming the checkable authority. When evidence says a figure is unverified and directs that no number be quoted (CT absolute pardon), quote none — not even labelled unverified.

5. HELD FORMS. Check the corpus index by state. A form is included as a source-referenced component ONLY when a committed record connects it to the route's own step (SBI-FORM-46: the counsel record's review step; DPS-0846-C: the memo's supportingDocuments). Bind by committed hash + byte length; never embed or redistribute bytes; let the shared builder recompute from mounted bytes when the library is present. A corpus form that merely shares the state is not a component (NM: the DPS-ROI form belongs to other routes and was left out).

6. NEGATIVE FACTS ARE DELIVERABLE CONTENT. 'No held source identifies the receiving office' becomes the packet's most important participant stop (NM), and 'the accepted format is unconfirmed' becomes the reason no instrument is drafted (CT destruction). Do not paper over a gap the evidence records — carry it.

7. DETERMINISM PROOF. Build twice, sha256sum the whole output tree, diff must be empty. The shared builder keeps timestamps and environment values out of every output; keep it that way — per-run facts (like whether the library was mounted) go to stdout and to this return, never into output files.

8. REPORTS. The shared builder writes the six-file set (participant-instructions.md, source-receipt.json, reports/rendered-artifacts.json, build-status.json, build-findings.json, approval-request.json). rendered-artifacts.json states the completeness-audit boundary in terms; do not weaken the completeness verifier to make these families 'auditable'.

9. BOUNDARIES. Never draft the agency's own application when no stable participant document is identified (an intake worksheet is not the legal filing packet). Never write a signature field. Never touch a sibling court route that is hard-gated (AL de novo). state_built is the end: release the claim after the build commit, open nothing commercial.
